abstract: Although flexible employment policies can help employed individuals balance caregiving and paid work, limited evidence has been devoted to examining the effect of working flexibly on the supply of care to older adults. In this paper, we study the impact of flexible working conditions on the supply of informal adult care and mental health. We exploit variation from the 2014 expansion of the Right to Request Flexible Work (RRFW) to employees in the UK. Our findings point to a gendered response to increased employment flexibility. We document a 1.3-percentage-point increase in the likelihood that men provide informal care within the household, alongside less regular daytime work, greater control over working hours, and higher engagement in home production. In contrast, among potential female caregivers, we find that the reform reduced the probability of high-intensity caregiving, which is typically incompatible with employment or related activities. We document that the increased workplace flexibility not only encourages caregiving but also helps reduce gender disparities in unpaid care. We additionally find suggestive evidence of improved mental health outcomes, particularly among men.
abstract_zh: 尽管弹性就业政策有助于在职人员平衡照护责任与有偿工作，但关于弹性工作安排对老年人照护供给影响的实证证据仍然有限。本文研究了弹性工作条件对非正式成人照护供给及心理健康的影响。我们利用2014年英国《弹性工作请求权利》（RRFW）扩展至雇员的政策变动作为识别策略。研究结果揭示了就业弹性增加带来的性别差异化反应。我们发现，男性在家庭内提供非正式照护的可能性上升了1.3个百分点，同时其常规日间工作时间减少、对工作时间的掌控力增强，且参与家庭生产的程度提高。相比之下，在潜在的女性照护者群体中，该改革降低了高强度照护的概率，而高强度照护通常与就业或相关活动难以兼容。我们进一步发现，工作场所弹性的增加不仅促进了照护供给，还有助于缩小无偿照护中的性别差距。此外，我们还发现了心理健康状况改善的初步证据，尤其是在男性群体中。
title: Caring Flexibly? Working Conditions and the Supply of Adult Care
title_zh: 灵活关怀？工作条件与成人照护供给

abstract: Most countries use export credit agencies (ECAs) to mitigate export‐related credit constraints. Only few firms benefit directly from these credit schemes. In this paper, I analyze potential spillover effects from export credit guarantees to other firms. Using firm‐level data from the Danish ECA and exploiting detailed firm‐product‐level production and purchase statistics, I derive new measures for horizontal and backward spillovers at the firm‐product and firm levels. Results show that potential suppliers upstream increase their sales of those products that are purchased by the firm(s) receiving export credit guarantees. Moreover, employment and total sales of potential suppliers increase as well. These findings speak to the transmission of large export shocks (here reflected in the issuance of export credit guarantees) to other domestic firms via customer‐supplier linkages. In contrast, I find little evidence of negative effects on domestic producers when export credit guarantees are given to their competitors.
abstract_zh: 大多数国家通过出口信用机构（ECAs）来缓解与出口相关的信贷约束，但仅有少数企业能直接受益于这些信贷计划。本文分析了出口信用担保对其他企业的潜在溢出效应。基于丹麦出口信用机构的企业层面数据，并利用详细的企业-产品层面生产与采购统计，我在企业-产品和企业层面构建了横向与后向溢出的新测度指标。研究结果表明，上游潜在供应商会增加其向获得出口信用担保的企业所采购产品的销售额。此外，这些潜在供应商的就业与总销售额也同步增长。这些发现揭示了大型出口冲击（此处体现为出口信用担保的发放）如何通过客户-供应商关联传导至国内其他企业。相比之下，当出口信用担保给予竞争对手时，我并未发现对国内生产者产生负面效应的显著证据。
title: Spillovers from export credit guarantees
title_zh: 出口信用担保的溢出效应

abstract: In recent decades, Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS) have increasingly been used to certify products and their production processes, aiming to reduce negative externalities. Understanding the impact of VSS on agricultural trade flows is crucial, especially for developing countries where agriculture holds greater relative significance within the economy. Using a gravity model, we examine how VSS certification affects exports of eight highly traded agricultural commodities under 12 VSS schemes between 2013 and 2021. The findings show that a 1% increase in VSS coverage leads to a 1.88% rise in exports, although higher certification levels result in diminishing trade effects. Commodities such as bananas, palm oil, tea, and cotton benefit most from VSS certification. Trade gains are also more significant for lower‐income countries exporting to high‐income markets, as VSS help reduce information asymmetries. However, export gains for developing countries often come at the expense of domestic consumption, as VSS adoption tends to reallocate sales toward foreign markets. This substitution effect is stronger in poorer countries and weakens as exporters become richer, with the highest‐income developing countries managing to expand both domestic and foreign sales. We also observe empirical evidence that VSS proliferation and increased foreign competition diminish these benefits for major agricultural producers.
title: Friends or Foes? The Impact of Voluntary Sustainability Standards on Agricultural Exports of Developing Countries

abstract: We consider a semiparametric multinomial choice model that allows for an arbitrary joint distribution of choice specific unobservables that are independent of explanatory variables. This model permits relatively flexible substitution patterns between choices. To minimize computational difficulties, we restrict attention on estimators of the model that can be expressed in closed form. We combine and extend various results from the existing literature to enforce economic restrictions implied by the model and to attain “as efficient estimators as we can” - given the closed form requirement. Some aspects of our estimators achieve the semiparametric efficiency bound, while others do not. In Monte-Carlo experiments, we study how various strategies increase efficiency, and compare the efficiency of our best estimators to computationally more challenging, non-closed form, estimators that are efficient.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个半参数多项选择模型，该模型允许选择特定不可观测因素具有任意联合分布，且这些因素与解释变量相互独立。此模型能够容纳选择之间相对灵活的替代模式。为减少计算难度，我们仅关注能以闭式形式表达的模型估计量。我们结合并扩展现有文献中的多种结果，以施加模型隐含的经济约束，并在闭式要求下尽可能实现“高效估计”。我们提出的估计量在某些方面达到了半参数效率界，而在其他方面则未达到。通过蒙特卡洛实验，我们研究了不同策略如何提升效率，并将我们最优估计量的效率与计算上更具挑战性、非闭式但高效的估计量进行了比较。
title: Closed Form Estimators for a Class of Semiparametric Multinomial Choice Models

abstract: We show that, for a certain class of scaling matrices including the inverse square-root of the conditional Fisher information, score-driven factor models are identifiable up to a multiplicative scalar constant under very mild restrictions. This result has no analogue in parameter-driven models, as it exploits the different structure of the score-driven factor dynamics. Consequently, score-driven factor models overcome the issue of rotational invariance that typically affects dynamic factor models, thereby enhancing the economic and financial interpretability of the estimated factors. Our restrictions are order-invariant and can be generalized to score-driven factor models with dynamic loadings and nonlinear factor models. We test extensively the identification strategy using simulated and real data. The empirical analysis on financial and macroeconomic data reveals a substantial increase of log-likelihood ratios and significantly improved out-of-sample forecast performance when switching from the classical restrictions adopted in the literature to our more flexible specifications.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于包括条件Fisher信息逆平方根在内的某类缩放矩阵，得分驱动因子模型在非常宽松的限制下可识别至多一个乘性标量常数。这一结果在参数驱动模型中并无对应，因为它利用了得分驱动因子动态的不同结构。因此，得分驱动因子模型克服了通常影响动态因子模型的旋转不变性问题，从而增强了估计因子的经济与金融可解释性。我们的限制具有顺序不变性，并可推广至具有动态载荷的得分驱动因子模型及非线性因子模型。我们通过模拟和真实数据广泛检验了识别策略。对金融和宏观经济数据的实证分析显示，当从文献中采用的经典限制转向我们更灵活的规格时，对数似然比显著增加，且样本外预测性能大幅提升。
title: From rotational to scalar invariance: Enhancing identifiability in score-driven factor models

abstract: We examine pharmaceutical regulations and incentives for innovation from an international perspective, highlighting the public good nature of healthcare innovation and its cross-border diffusion. We summarize the empirical evidence on how push and pull incentives shape R\D investment, innovation, and global access. We emphasize the role of strategic interdependencies and spillovers, including free-riding in R\D financing, learning-by-doing effects, drug shortages, reference pricing, and parallel trade. We then provide new evidence on the international spillovers of pull incentives on innovation, showing that international cooperation and innovative institutions are necessary to better align national regulations with the global objective of sustaining pharmaceutical innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们从国际视角审视药品监管与创新激励，强调医疗创新及其跨国传播的公共产品属性。我们总结了关于推动与拉动激励如何影响研发投资、创新及全球可及性的实证证据。我们着重探讨战略相互依赖与溢出效应，包括研发融资中的搭便车行为、干中学效应、药品短缺、参考定价及平行贸易。随后，我们提供了关于拉动激励对创新国际溢出的新证据，表明国际合作与创新制度对于更好地协调国家监管与维持药品创新的全球目标至关重要。

abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能带来显著的体重下降，并可能同时改变社会与经济结果。利用“理解美国研究”数据，我将开始使用GLP-1进行减肥的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未开始使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的结婚/同居率上升了29个百分点，基线时未就业女性的就业率上升了27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未解体，而已就业女性未表现出向上的职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的一部分作用于新匹配的形成过程，而非仅通过健康或现有员工生产力发挥作用。
title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚

abstract: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) changed incentives for individual and employer-sponsored insurance. Using unique small group market (SGM) data with detailed claims and enrollment information, we analyze the welfare gains across households in the SGM from alternative formulations of ACA health insurance exchanges (HIXs). Accounting for observable heterogeneity increases estimated demand elasticities. Shutting down the SGM would reduce equilibrium adverse selection in HIX-type markets, increasing welfare for households moved to HIXs by $842 annually. The majority of households would obtain higher equilibrium welfare from HIXs, stemming from having more choices. Adding the 2014 ACA penalties only modestly decreases adverse selection.
abstract_zh: 《平价医疗法案》（ACA）改变了对个人及雇主赞助保险的激励。利用包含详细理赔和参保信息的独特小团体市场（SGM）数据，我们分析了ACA健康保险交易所（HIXs）不同方案下小团体市场中各家庭福利收益的变化。考虑可观测异质性会提高估计的需求弹性。关闭小团体市场将减少HIX型市场中的均衡逆向选择，使迁至HIX的家庭每年福利增加842美元。大多数家庭将从HIX中获得更高的均衡福利，这源于更多的选择。加入2014年ACA罚则仅略微降低了逆向选择。
title: Group Health Insurance Versus ACA Marketplaces: Selection, Subsidies, and Welfare
title_zh: 团体健康保险与ACA市场：选择、补贴与福利

abstract: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.
abstract_zh: 医疗改革常常在实施前就已颁布，由此产生的不确定性可能影响企业的决策。我们利用2000-2009年机构层面的数据，考察了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业，并利用D部分对老年人口比例较高的县影响更大的事实。与概念模型的预测一致——该模型认为实施前的不确定性抑制了市场进入，而实施后较低的利润率阻碍了完全恢复——我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%相关，这一减少主要由新开药店数量下降而非关闭数量增加所致。我们还发现了初步证据表明，药店可及性的降低削弱了D部分在降低死亡率方面的益处。
title: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
title_zh: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药店行业的证据

abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题，这些退伍军人有资格同时通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）和由联邦医疗保险（Medicare）资助的私营提供者获得医疗服务。我们分析了那些迁移至VA利用率不同地区的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）与地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量和便利性）的相对重要性。我们的估计表明，VA使用中50%至60%的地理差异可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还记录了不同护理类型间的重要异质性，其中地区因素对住院和急诊护理的影响大于对门诊和初级护理的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法中强调的供给侧特征——与VA设施的距离和等待时间——仅解释了估计的地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA利用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。
title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系之间的选择：来自退伍军人的证据

abstract: We investigate the importance of subjective expectations of returns to and effort costs of the two principal investments that mothers make in newborns: breastfeeding and stimulation. We find heterogeneity across mothers in rural Pakistan in expected effort costs and expected returns for outcomes in the cognitive, socio-emotional and health domains, and that this contributes to explaining heterogeneity in investments. We find no significant differences across women in preferences for child developmental outcomes. We simulate the impact of alternative policies on investments. Our findings highlight the relevance of interventions designed to address maternal depression and reduce perinatal fatigue alongside interventions that increase perceived returns to investments.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了母亲对新生儿的两项主要投资——母乳喂养和刺激——的预期回报与努力成本的主观重要性。在巴基斯坦农村地区，我们发现母亲们在认知、社会情感和健康领域的结果预期努力成本和预期回报上存在异质性，并且这种异质性有助于解释投资上的差异。我们发现，在儿童发展结果的偏好上，女性之间没有显著差异。我们模拟了不同政策对投资的影响。研究结果强调了针对母亲抑郁和减少围产期疲劳的干预措施，以及提高投资感知回报的干预措施的相关性。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为巴基斯坦农村母亲，数据与制度背景均非中国，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: Maternal Investments in Children: The Role of Expected Effort and Returns
title_zh: 母亲对子女的投资：预期努力与回报的作用

abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在2004年印度洋地震与海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害背景下，意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。利用“海啸后果与恢复研究”中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率的影响与个体特定近亲丧失的影响进行了对比。短期内，即海啸后两年，社区和个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁和创伤后应激症状升高的显著预测因子。长期来看，即海啸后十年，个体层面的暴露效应略有减弱，但仍对两种心理社会健康指标构成显著预测；相比之下，社区层面的死亡率预测创伤后应激症状，但不预测抑郁症状。死亡率与短期和长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，尽管后者的效应在男性和女性之间存在显著差异。估计值对其他海啸暴露指标进行了调整，在个体层面分析中，我们比较了海啸发生时居住在同一社区、面临相同社区死亡率的人群。
title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉

abstract: The growing prevalence of cognitive impairment (CI) is one of the main drivers of age-related demand for health and long-term care (LTC). In Spain, CI is estimated to affect 18.5% of Spaniards over 65, and 45.3% in those aged 85 and above. This paper draws on a pooled pre-COVID data from a longitudinal sample of individuals aged 65+ to examine the effect of CI and physical limitations on health and long-term care utilisation, estimates its costs, and financial burden. We report four sets of findings. First, we find that socioeconomic status at older age to be the strongest predictor of CI. Second, while both CI and physical limitations increase health and care adult care use, physical impairment is a stronger predictor of overall care utilisation (73% versus 55% for CI alone) and nursing home residence (2.0% versus 0.9%). Third, informal caregiving constitutes the overwhelming majority of dementia costs, accounting for 69–81% of the total. Finally, we estimate that the replacement cost of informal care would exhaust the full budget of Spain’s LTC system (SAAD).
abstract_zh: 认知障碍（CI）患病率的不断上升是年龄相关健康与长期护理（LTC）需求的主要驱动因素之一。在西班牙，据估计65岁以上人群中有18.5%受到认知障碍影响，而85岁及以上人群中这一比例达到45.3%。本文利用新冠疫情前65岁以上个体纵向样本的合并数据，考察认知障碍和身体限制对健康及长期护理使用的影响，估算其成本及经济负担。我们报告四组研究发现。首先，我们发现老年期的社会经济地位是认知障碍最强的预测因子。其次，尽管认知障碍和身体限制均会增加健康及成人护理服务的使用，但身体损伤对总体护理使用（单独认知障碍为55%，身体损伤为73%）和养老院居住（认知障碍为0.9%，身体损伤为2.0%）的预测力更强。第三，非正式照护在痴呆症成本中占据绝对主导地位，占总成本的69%至81%。最后，我们估算，非正式照护的替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理体系（SAAD）的全部预算。
title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
title_zh: 西班牙长期护理与认知障碍研究

abstract: We document racial disparities in total and out-of-pocket medical expenditures, using data from the Health and Retirement Study linked to Medicare and Medicaid records. While White, Black, and Hispanic households have similar total annual medical expenditures, minorities benefit from higher Medicaid recipiency and face lower out-of-pocket spending. At age 65, White, Black, and Hispanic households incur on average $136,000, $59,000, and $68,000, respectively, in out-of-pocket medical spending over the remainders of their lives. We use our model to evaluate a policy reform that expands public nursing home insurance. Given that White households currently pay the most out-of-pocket, they have the most to gain from the reform. In the absence of a highly redistributive funding scheme, this reform will on average redistribute financial resources from minorities to White households, illustrating how expanding public insurance can have unintended distributional consequences.
abstract_zh: 我们利用健康与退休研究数据，结合医疗保险和医疗补助记录，记录了总医疗支出及自付医疗支出中的种族差异。尽管白人、黑人和西班牙裔家庭在年度总医疗支出上相近，但少数族裔受益于更高的医疗补助覆盖率，自付支出较低。在65岁时，白人、黑人和西班牙裔家庭在余生中平均分别承担136,000美元、59,000美元和68,000美元的自付医疗费用。我们运用模型评估了一项扩大公共养老院保险的政策改革。鉴于目前白人家庭自付支出最高，他们从改革中获益最多。在没有高度再分配性质的筹资机制下，这项改革平均而言会将财政资源从少数族裔转移至白人家庭，这说明了扩大公共保险可能带来意想不到的分配后果。
title: Medical Spending Risk among Older Households by Race
title_zh: 不同种族老年家庭医疗支出风险研究

abstract: This paper examines the nature of long-term care for older adults with cognitive impairments in England. Long-term care (LTC), which in England is commonly referred to as adult social care, is care that supports daily activities of living for older and disabled individuals to enhance their quality of life. This includes care services ranging from nursing home stays to home-based assistance with tasks like washing, dressing, and eating. For older people with cognitive impairment, such as dementia for example, there may be additional specialized care and support that is necessary. This paper shows that the high care needs of older individuals is largely attributable to those with cognitive impairments: approximately half of the total care costs of the age 65+ population in England are attributable to the 8.5% of individuals with cognitive limitations.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了英格兰认知障碍老年人长期照护的性质。长期照护（LTC），在英格兰通常被称为成人社会照护，是指支持老年人和残障人士日常生活活动以提升其生活质量的照护。这包括从养老院住宿到居家协助（如洗漱、穿衣和进食）等一系列照护服务。对于患有认知障碍（如痴呆症）的老年人，可能还需要额外的专业照护和支持。本文表明，老年人的高照护需求主要归因于认知障碍人群：在英格兰65岁及以上人口中，约占总照护成本一半的费用可归因于仅占8.5%的认知受限个体。
title: The Costs of Long Term Care for those with Cognitive Impairments in England
title_zh: 英格兰认知障碍患者的长期护理成本

abstract: We estimate a model of savings for retired couples and singles who face longevity and medical expense risks, and in which couples can leave bequests both when the first and last spouse dies. We show that saving motives vary by marital status, permanent income, and age. We find that most households save more for medical expenses than for bequests, but that richer households and couples, who hold most of the wealth, save more for bequests. As a result, bequest motives are a key determinant of aggregate retirement wealth.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了一个针对退休夫妇及单身人士的储蓄模型，该模型考虑了长寿风险与医疗支出风险，并允许夫妇在首位配偶去世及最后一位配偶去世时均可留下遗产。研究表明，储蓄动机因婚姻状况、永久收入及年龄而异。我们发现，大多数家庭为医疗支出储蓄的金额超过为遗产储蓄的金额，但较富裕的家庭及夫妇，由于持有大部分财富，其储蓄更多是为了遗产。因此，遗产动机成为决定总体退休财富的关键因素。
title: Why Do Couples and Singles Save during Retirement? Household Heterogeneity and its Aggregate Implications
title_zh: 为什么夫妻和单身人士在退休期间储蓄？家庭异质性及其总体影响

abstract: This paper describes the state of Long-Term Care (LTC) in England. LTC, which is generally referred to in England as adult social care, supports activities of daily living for older and disabled individuals to improve their quality of life. This includes stays in nursing homes as well as home-based help with tasks such as washing, dressing, and feeding.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了英格兰长期护理（LTC）的现状。长期护理在英格兰通常被称为成人社会关怀，旨在支持老年人和残障人士的日常生活活动，以提升其生活质量。这包括在养老院的居住，以及诸如洗漱、穿衣和进食等家庭护理帮助。
title: Long-Term Care in England
title_zh: 英格兰长期护理制度研究

abstract: While economists have extensively studied gender norms affecting women, masculinity norms---social norms about how men should behave ---remain underexplored. This review first synthesizes how other disciplines have studied masculinity, providing economists with conceptual foundations and empirical patterns for understanding masculinity norms. We then discuss how the study of masculinity norms can inform the economics literature on gender gaps and men
abstract_zh: 尽管经济学家已广泛研究了影响女性的性别规范，但关于男性应如何行为的社会规范——即男性气质规范——仍未被充分探索。本综述首先综合了其他学科对男性气质的研究，为经济学家理解男性气质规范提供了概念基础和实证模式。随后，我们探讨了男性气质规范的研究如何为关于性别差距和男性的经济学文献提供启示。
title: Masculinity Norms and Their Economic Implications
title_zh: 男性气质规范及其经济影响

abstract: Healthcare providers are a frontline channel for detecting intimate partner violence (IPV): physicians are legally required to report suspected criminal injuries to the authorities and can refer victims to support and protection services. We study how restricting healthcare access affects the detection and formal reporting of IPV, exploiting a 2012 Spanish reform that withdrew public healthcare entitlement from undocumented immigrants while leaving emergency care universally accessible. Using a difference-in-differences design that compares foreign and Spanish-national women before and after the reform, we find that foreign women
abstract_zh: 医疗服务提供者是识别亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）的前线渠道：医生在法律上有义务将疑似刑事伤害报告给当局，并可引导受害者获得支持与保护服务。我们利用2012年西班牙改革——该改革取消了无证移民的公共医疗资格，但保留了急诊服务的全民可及性——来研究限制医疗获取如何影响IPV的检测与正式报告。采用双重差分设计，比较改革前后外国籍与西班牙籍女性，我们发现外国女性
title: Losing Coverage, Losing Voice: Healthcare Access and Intimate Partner Violence Reporting
title_zh: 失去保障，失去声音：医疗可及性与亲密伴侣暴力举报

abstract: There is limited evidence on the non-health impacts of air pollution, including productivity in the workplace and behavior. We examine the effect of air pollution on participation, collaboration, and feedback provision in a workplace setting. Our experiment randomly assigns air purifiers to rooms at three large academic conferences to investigate the causal impact of air pollution on participants
abstract_zh: 关于空气污染对非健康领域影响的研究证据有限，包括工作场所的生产力和行为方面。我们考察了空气污染对工作场所参与度、协作及反馈提供的影响。我们的实验在三场大型学术会议中随机分配空气净化器至各房间，以探究空气污染对参与者的因果效应。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于学术会议实验，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者虽含华人姓名但主题不指向中国。
title: Air Quality and Conferences' Engagement
title_zh: 空气质量与会议参与度

abstract: This paper examines how early socio-emotional skills shape adolescent offending in England and the school pathways through which they operate. I use administrative data linking teacher-reported child development assessments at age five to school and criminal justice records through age 17. Factor analysis of these assessments reveals two underlying domains of early difficulty, cognitive and socio-emotional. Both raise the probability of a caution or conviction between ages 11 and 17 by around 15%, but through distinct channels. Cognitive difficulties act primarily through academic attainment, while socio-emotional difficulties operate largely through school exclusions yet retain a substantial direct effect, accounting for around 40% of the total effect. The socio-emotional effect is robust to unobserved school and family heterogeneity and shapes both the type and frequency of offending. Statutory support for learning difficulties and social care services attenuates the associations between early skill deficits and offending. These findings suggest that differentiated support is needed based on the type of difficulty.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了早期社会情感技能如何塑造英格兰青少年的犯罪行为及其通过学校路径发挥作用的机制。我利用行政数据，将五岁时教师评估的儿童发展结果与至17岁的学校及刑事司法记录相链接。对这些评估的因子分析揭示了早期困难的两个潜在领域：认知与社会情感。两者均使11至17岁期间受到警告或定罪的概率提高约15%，但通过不同的渠道发挥作用。认知困难主要通过学业成就起作用，而社会情感困难则主要通过学校排斥产生影响，但仍保留显著的直接效应，约占总效应的40%。社会情感效应在考虑未观测到的学校与家庭异质性后依然稳健，并影响犯罪类型及频率。针对学习困难和社会关怀服务的法定支持减弱了早期技能缺陷与犯罪行为之间的关联。这些发现表明，根据困难类型需要提供差异化的支持。
title: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
title_zh: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据

abstract: Public goods are meant to be universal, but they are inherently place-based. This paper systematically measures spatial access to public goods and quantifies the implications of distance to public facilities for income inequality. First, we map all schools and hospitals across Belgium. We compute the distance to facilities for each of the 20, 000 neighborhoods and document large spatial inequalities in access to public facilities. Second, we find that this unequal distribution favors high-income neighborhoods: allocating public goods spending proportionally to our access index increases income inequality compared to measures based solely on disposable income. Third, we show that the positive relationship between income and access can be rationalized by a simple model of public goods allocation with an inequality-neutral social planner. Finally, we provide evidence that access is strongly correlated with educational and health outcomes, emphasizing the need to consider the place-based nature of public goods when measuring inequality.
abstract_zh: 公共物品本应具有普遍性，但其本质上却具有地域性。本文系统衡量了公共物品的空间可达性，并量化了距离公共设施远近对收入不平等的影响。首先，我们绘制了比利时所有学校和医院的地图，计算了2万个社区中每个社区到设施的距离，并记录了公共设施可达性方面的巨大空间不平等。其次，我们发现这种不平等分布有利于高收入社区：与仅基于可支配收入的衡量标准相比，按我们的可达性指数比例分配公共物品支出会增加收入不平等。第三，我们证明收入与可达性之间的正相关关系可以通过一个具有不平等中立社会规划者的简单公共物品分配模型来合理化。最后，我们提供的证据表明，可达性与教育和健康结果密切相关，强调在衡量不平等时需要考虑公共物品的地域性特征。
title: Do Public Goods Actually Reduce Inequality?
title_zh: 公共物品真的能减少不平等吗？

abstract: Road traffic injuries are the leading cause of death among people aged 5–29. Where traffic laws are weakly enforced, it is unclear whether road safety interventions can change behavior. We run a randomized controlled trial among 203 Kenyan minibuses, testing whether an incentive scheme improves safety overall or merely shifts unsafe driving to unmonitored times. Drivers reduce speeding by 29 percent and harsh braking by 13 percent, improving a safety index by 0.096 standard deviations. Labor-supply and earnings effects are modest, with little displacement across times or places. Improvements fade quickly, suggesting lasting change requires sustained enforcement or stronger incentives.
abstract_zh: 道路交通伤害是5至29岁人群的首要死因。在交通法规执行不力的地区，道路安全干预措施能否改变行为尚不明确。我们在203辆肯尼亚小巴中开展了一项随机对照试验，检验激励计划是全面改善安全状况，还是仅仅将不安全驾驶行为转移至未受监控的时间段。驾驶员超速行为减少29%，急刹车行为减少13%，安全指数提升0.096个标准差。劳动力供给和收入效应较为温和，且在不同时间或地点间几乎没有转移效应。改善效果迅速消退，表明持久改变需要持续执法或更强激励。
title: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
title_zh: 价格更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据

abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1, 200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of −0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于养老金收入如何影响退休后劳动供给的因果证据。我们利用德国收入型养老金补贴（Grundrente）的引入，该改革永久性地提高了具有较长缴费历史且终身收入相对较低的退休人员的养老金收入。这一改革在非劳动收入中产生了外生变动，而未造成额外的劳动供给扭曲，使我们能够分离出纯粹的收入效应。利用覆盖德国全体退休人员的行政数据以及双重差分设计，我们发现年度养老金收入增加1200欧元会使无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，这意味着非劳动收入的边际赚取倾向为-0.1。这一反应的三分之二来自集约边际调整，其通过增加退出和减少重新进入两种途径发挥作用，其余部分则由集约边际减少驱动。效应在更年轻、劳动市场依附性更强的群体中更为显著。
title: Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
title_zh: 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给

abstract: In this paper we evaluate the challenges of funding retirement in the aftermath of the Covid pandemic. We first show that the pandemic had only modest effects on life expectancy and employment. These effects were small relative to longer term trends. Nevertheless, they worsened pension funding problems, highlighting the need for future pension reforms. Next, we highlight key evidence on how labor supply responds to pension reforms. Evidence suggests that incentivising later retirement can reduce pension deficits.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了新冠疫情后退休资金筹措面临的挑战。我们首先指出，疫情对预期寿命和就业的影响相对有限，这些影响相较于长期趋势而言较小。然而，它们加剧了养老金资金问题，凸显了未来养老金改革的必要性。接着，我们重点展示了劳动力供给如何响应养老金改革的关键证据。证据表明，激励延迟退休有助于减少养老金赤字。
title: Retirement Policy in a Post-Covid World
title_zh: 后疫情时代的退休政策

abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们发现，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治结盟。由于地缘政治结盟国家经历更为同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为合理化这些模式，我们将地缘政治考量引入主权借款的有限承诺模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款引向盟国，并削弱风险分担。
title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

abstract: Australia's natural environment has been devastated by decades of land clearing, habitat destruction, invasive species and climate change—and the economics discipline has largely looked the other way. In November 2025, the Australian Parliament passed landmark amendments to the Environmental Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act. These reforms are a game‐changer—but they are just a start. Restoration at scale must follow, properly funded and integrated with climate policy; anything less is a betrayal of future generations. Rebuilding natural capital is not a discretionary amenity. For this and every subsequent generation of Australians, it is a matter of survival.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚的自然环境因数十年的土地开垦、栖息地破坏、入侵物种和气候变化而遭受重创——而经济学学科在很大程度上对此视而不见。2025年11月，澳大利亚议会通过了《环境保护与生物多样性保护法》（EPBC Act）具有里程碑意义的修正案。这些改革是颠覆性的变革——但这仅仅是开始。必须随之开展大规模生态修复，并确保资金充足且与气候政策相整合；任何不足都是对子孙后代的背叛。重建自然资本并非可选择的便利设施。对于这一代及未来每一代澳大利亚人而言，这关乎生存。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Environmental Reforms to Secure Intergenerational Justice: An Edited Extract from the Address to the 2026 AARES Conference, Adelaide
title_zh: 确保代际公平的环境改革：2026年AARES阿德莱德会议致辞节选

abstract: Investors and policymakers are increasingly relying on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics to inform capital allocation and regulatory decisions. However, prior research on the link between ESG and financial performance (FP) has yielded mixed results, ranging from positive to neutral and negative associations. These inconsistencies stem from a lack of sector-specific analysis and insufficient treatment of endogeneity. This study addresses these gaps by adopting a sector-based approach and employing the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) panel regression to control for endogeneity, ensuring more robust and unbiased estimates. Using 15,886 U.S. firm-year observations from 2017 to 2023, the study evaluates market-based (excess return), accounting-based (ROA and ROE), and financial stability indicators (Altman Z-score and Kaplan-Zingales KZ Index). It also compares results across periods that include and exclude the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings reveal that ESG performance has a significant influence on financial outcomes, but the effects vary across sectors and performance measures. ESG is positively associated with financial flexibility (KZ Index) in most sectors, while its impact on ROA and ROE is more inconsistent. Sectors such as Energy, Utilities, and Consumer Staples benefit the most from ESG engagement, whereas Healthcare and Communication Services may face ESG-related trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 投资者和政策制定者日益依赖环境、社会和治理（ESG）指标来指导资本配置和监管决策。然而，先前关于ESG与财务绩效（FP）之间关系的研究得出了不一致的结论，包括正向、中性和负向关联。这些不一致源于缺乏行业特定分析以及对内生性问题的处理不足。本研究通过采用基于行业的方法，并运用广义矩估计（GMM）面板回归来控制内生性，从而弥补上述不足，确保估计结果更加稳健且无偏。基于2017年至2023年间15,886个美国公司-年度观测值，本研究评估了市场导向指标（超额收益）、会计导向指标（ROA和ROE）以及财务稳定性指标（Altman Z值和Kaplan-Zingales KZ指数），并比较了包含与排除COVID-19疫情时期的结果。研究发现，ESG绩效对财务结果具有显著影响，但其效应因行业和绩效衡量指标而异。在大多数行业中，ESG与财务灵活性（KZ指数）呈正相关，而对ROA和ROE的影响则更不一致。能源、公用事业和必需消费品行业从ESG参与中获益最多，而医疗保健和通信服务行业可能面临与ESG相关的权衡。
title: ESG Value in US firms: sectoral dynamics with a COVID-19 perspective
title_zh: 美国企业ESG价值：基于新冠疫情视角的行业动态分析

abstract: This paper proposes a non-cooperative game of network formation in which creating access to the network – for oneself and others – is a public good. Link formation therefore reflects a trade-off between the social value of links and their private cost. The paper characterizes the architecture of strict Nash networks. Strict Nash equilibria are either flat or hierarchical. Flat equilibria consist of a wheel (i.e., a directed cycle) that may or may not encompass all agents. Hierarchical equilibria are trees in which some agents act as intermediaries between otherwise disconnected groups. When the cost of link formation is sufficiently low, the exhaustive wheel is the unique equilibrium architecture and best-response dynamics converge to it with probability one. For intermediate costs, multiple equilibrium architectures coexist and can be Pareto-ranked: the exhaustive wheels dominate the non-exhaustive ones and the empty network, and trees dominate the empty network.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种网络形成的非合作博弈模型，在该模型中，为自己及他人创建网络接入具有公共品属性。因此，链接形成反映了链接的社会价值与其私人成本之间的权衡。本文刻画了严格纳什网络的架构特征。严格纳什均衡要么是扁平结构，要么是层级结构。扁平均衡由轮状结构（即有向环）构成，该结构可能包含所有参与者，也可能不包含。层级均衡则呈现树状结构，其中部分参与者充当原本互不相连群体之间的中介。当链接形成成本足够低时，全覆盖轮状结构是唯一的均衡架构，且最优反应动态以概率1收敛于此结构。在中等成本条件下，多种均衡架构并存且可进行帕累托排序：全覆盖轮状结构优于非全覆盖轮状结构及空网络，而树状结构优于空网络。

title: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives

abstract: Mental health disorders account for a significant share of the overall global disease burden. The economic losses from such disorders are staggeringly large, particularly in low-income countries, where people are faced with several unexpected shocks. We test whether improved communication can mitigate such mental health disorders. Partnering with a major telecommunications company, we implement low-cost communication interventions that provide mobile calling credits to a nationally representative set of low-income adults in Ghana during the COVID-19 pandemic. Individuals’ inability to make unexpected calls, need to borrow SOS airtime, and to seek digital loans decreased significantly relative to a control group. As a result, the programs led to a significant decrease in mental distress (-9.7%), the likelihood of severe mental distress by -2.3 percentage points (a quarter of the mean prevalence), and domestic violence, with null impact on overall consumption expenditure. The effects are stronger for monthly mobile credits than a lump-sum. We present evidence that improvements in both business-related services and social inclusion and/or protection are relevant explanations. Simple cost-benefit analysis shows that providing communication credit to low-income adults is a cost-effective policy for improving mental health. Communication – the ability to stay connected – meaningfully improves mental well-being and interventions about communication are particularly valuable when implemented as many installments.
abstract_zh: 心理健康障碍在全球疾病总负担中占据显著比例。此类障碍造成的经济损失极为巨大，尤其在低收入国家，民众常面临多重突发冲击。本研究检验了改善通信条件能否缓解此类心理健康障碍。我们与一家大型电信公司合作，在新冠疫情期间向加纳具有全国代表性的低收入成年人群体实施低成本通信干预措施，即提供手机通话信用额度。相较于对照组，干预对象在无法进行紧急通话、需要借用应急通话时长以及寻求数字贷款等方面的状况显著减少。由此，这些干预措施显著降低了心理困扰程度（-9.7%），使严重心理困扰的发生概率下降2.3个百分点（相当于平均患病率的四分之一），并减少了家庭暴力现象，但对总体消费支出无显著影响。按月发放手机信用额度的效果优于一次性发放。我们提供的证据表明，商业相关服务的改善以及社会包容和/或保护机制的增强是合理的解释路径。简单的成本效益分析显示，向低收入成年人提供通信信用额度是一项具有成本效益的心理健康改善政策。通信——即保持联系的能力——能显著提升心理健康水平，而分多次实施的通信干预措施尤为有价值。
title: The Value of Communication for Mental Health

abstract: Balancing carbon reduction and local livelihoods has remained a persistent challenge in community carbon forestry management (CCFM). Current literature is increasingly acknowledging the need to reconcile individual and collective objectives in CCFM based on Ostromian polycentricity, yet it has not identified an optimal solution. We develop a “agency relationship-motivation strategy-property rights structure-outcomes” framework to unpack the responsibility system in China’s CCFM. Within this analytical framework, we first classify three forms of principal-agent relationships alongside their matching incentive strategies. Second, we unpack the interconnections among principal-agent relationships, motivation strategies, and property rights allocation. Finally, we argue that CCFM exhibits an ordered polycentric governance structure. Further, we apply the analytical framework to the CCFM case in Shunchang, Fujian, China, and find that: (i) three types of agency relationships in CCFM, i.e., delegation, administrative commission, and civil commission, match the intensity of the three motivation strategies (political incentives, economic incentives, and intrinsic incentives). (ii) agency relationships and motivation strategies jointly shape the property rights structure, e.g., principals under delegation possess authoritative rights; agents under delegation and principals under administrative commission exercise control rights; agents under administrative and civil commission exercise use rights. (iii) the effective integration of multiple principal-agent relationships shapes the ordered polycentric governance in China’s CCFM. The delegation addresses spatial integration challenges, and responds to political promotion demands; the administrative commission tackles institutional innovation dilemmas; the civil commission copes with social network extension issues. The analysis of CCFM within the Chinese context contributes to debates on the role of rural carbon forestry management in and beyond China.
abstract_zh: 平衡碳减排与地方生计一直是社区碳汇林业管理（CCFM）中的持续挑战。现有文献日益认识到，基于奥斯特罗姆式多中心理论，在CCFM中协调个体与集体目标之必要性，然而尚未找到最优解。我们构建了一个“委托代理关系—激励策略—产权结构—结果”的分析框架，以解析中国CCFM中的责任体系。在此分析框架内，我们首先将委托代理关系划分为三种形式，并匹配相应的激励策略。其次，我们揭示委托代理关系、激励策略与产权配置之间的内在联系。最后，我们认为CCFM呈现出有序的多中心治理结构。进一步地，我们将该分析框架应用于中国福建顺昌的CCFM案例，发现：（i）CCFM中的三类代理关系，即委托、行政委托和民事委托，与三种激励策略（政治激励、经济激励和内在激励）的强度相匹配。（ii）委托代理关系与激励策略共同塑造产权结构，例如，委托关系下的委托人拥有权威性权利；委托关系下的代理人和行政委托关系下的委托人行使控制权；行政委托和民事委托关系下的代理人行使使用权。（iii）多种委托代理关系的有效整合塑造了中国CCFM中的有序多中心治理。委托关系解决了空间整合挑战，并回应了政治晋升需求；行政委托应对了制度创新困境；民事委托处理了社会网络扩展问题。在中国语境下对CCFM的分析，为国内外农村碳汇林业管理作用的讨论作出了贡献。

abstract: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个面临具有加性且类型递增估值的知情消费者的多产品垄断者。当且仅当每对商品之间的边际替代率是单调的时，分离垄断定价对类型分布具有稳健最优性。这一结果是通过扩展传统的迈尔森方法得出的。
title: When is Separate Sales Optimal?
title_zh: 何时单独销售是最优的？

abstract: We study the anatomy of the international portfolio finance network. As global financial linkages have become denser over time, cross-border portfolio equity positions have grown in importance relative to debt for Emerging markets and Advanced economies. Using the framework developed by Stavrakeva and Rey (2024), we construct a novel proxy of daily foreign investor holdings in both equity and long-term sovereign debt markets across 32 currency areas. Leveraging an instrumental variable strategy, we identify an effect of foreign equity ETF inflows on exchange rates and local stock market prices. Our high-frequency proxy enables us to interpret episodes of turbulence in international finance. It should prove useful to assess how persistent the current shocks to the international financial system are likely to be.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际组合金融网络的结构。随着全球金融联系日益紧密，跨境组合股权头寸在新兴市场和发达经济体中的重要性相对于债务持续上升。基于Stavrakeva与Rey（2024）构建的分析框架，我们创新性地构建了涵盖32个货币区域的股票及长期主权债券市场每日外国投资者持有量的代理指标。通过工具变量策略，我们识别出外国股权ETF资金流入对汇率及本地股票市场价格存在显著影响。这一高频代理指标使我们能够解读国际金融市场的动荡时期，并为评估当前国际金融体系冲击的持续性提供分析工具。

title: Interpreting Turbulent Episodes in International Finance

abstract: US dollar appreciations can inflict sizable negative cross-border spillovers. We investigate such spillovers from flight-to-safety shocks and the accompanying "global dollar cycleâ€ . Our results show that negative real sector spillovers from US dollar appreciations fall disproportionately on emerging markets. In contrast, effects on advanced economies are small and short-lived. Emerging market commodity exporters historically experienced larger negative spillovers than commodity importers, reflecting a strong negative link between the US dollar and commodity prices. In terms of policies, more anchored inflation expectations can mitigate the initial negative spillovers, while more flexible exchange rates can speed up the subsequent economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 美元升值可能引发显著的负面跨境溢出效应。本文研究了避险冲击及其伴随的"全球美元周期"所产生的此类溢出效应。研究结果表明，美元升值对实体经济的负面溢出效应不成比例地集中于新兴市场。相比之下，对发达经济体的影响则较小且短暂。历史上，新兴市场中的大宗商品出口国比进口国承受了更大的负面溢出效应，这反映了美元与大宗商品价格之间存在强烈的负相关关系。在政策层面，更稳固的通胀预期能够缓解初始阶段的负面溢出效应，而更灵活的汇率制度则有助于加速后续的经济复苏。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为全球美元周期对新兴市场的影响，未提及中国数据、政策或制度背景。
title: Demand for Safe Assets and Spillovers from the Global Dollar Cycle
title_zh: 安全资产需求与全球美元周期的溢出效应

abstract: This paper introduces the African Debt Database (ADD) - a new, comprehensive dataset that traces both domestic and external debt instruments at a granular level. The main innovation is a detailed mapping of Africa's domestic debt markets, drawing on rich, new data extracted from government auction reports and bond prospectuses. The database covers over 50,000 individual government loans and securities issued by 54 African countries between 2000 and 2024, amounting to a total of USD 6.3 trillion in debt. For each instrument, it provides harmonized micro-level information on currency, maturity, interest rates, instrument type, and creditor. The data reveal the growing dominance of domestic debt in Africa - albeit with substantial cross-country variation. Four stylized facts stand out: (i) the rapid expansion of domestic debt markets, especially in middle-income countries; (ii) the wide dispersion in borrowing costs and real interest rates; (iii) large cross-country differences in maturity structures and associated rollover risks; and (iv) a rising debt-service burden, particularly due to international bonds. Generally, this project shows that debt transparency is both feasible and valuable, even in data-scarce environments.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了非洲债务数据库（ADD）——一个全新的、全面的数据集，该数据集以微观层面追踪了国内外债务工具。其主要创新在于，基于从政府拍卖报告和债券募集说明书中提取的丰富新数据，对非洲国内债务市场进行了详细映射。该数据库涵盖了2000年至2024年间54个非洲国家发行的超过5万笔政府贷款和证券，债务总额达6.3万亿美元。针对每项工具，它提供了关于货币、期限、利率、工具类型和债权人的统一微观层面信息。数据显示，非洲国内债务的主导地位日益增强——尽管各国之间存在显著差异。四个典型事实尤为突出：（i）国内债务市场快速扩张，尤其是在中等收入国家；（ii）借贷成本和实际利率存在广泛差异；（iii）期限结构及相关展期风险存在巨大的跨国差异；以及（iv）偿债负担不断上升，尤其是国际债券带来的负担。总体而言，本项目表明，即使在数据稀缺的环境中，债务透明度既可行又具有重要价值。
title: Africa's Domestic Debt Boom: Evidence from the African Debt Database
title_zh: 非洲国内债务激增：来自非洲债务数据库的证据

abstract: Global non-US banks have significant dollar exposure both on and off their balance sheet. We develop a model to analyze their adjustment to dollar funding shocks, whether from reduced direct lending or external dollar shortages. The model provides insight into banks' responses through borrowing, lending, and FX swap positions, as well as the impact on their net worth, their probability of default and CIP deviations. Implications of the model are confronted with data on the response of non-US global banks to major dollar funding shocks. We examine the benefits from buffering these shocks through central bank dollar swap lines or local currency lending by the central bank.
abstract_zh: 全球非美国银行在表内和表外均持有大量美元敞口。我们构建了一个模型，分析这些银行如何应对美元融资冲击——无论是来自直接贷款减少还是外部美元短缺。该模型揭示了银行通过借款、贷款及外汇掉期头寸的调整机制，以及这些调整对其净资产、违约概率和抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离的影响。我们将模型推论与全球非美国银行应对重大美元融资冲击的实际数据进行了对比验证。此外，我们评估了通过央行美元互换额度或央行本币贷款缓冲此类冲击的潜在收益。
title: Dollar Funding Fragility and non-US Global Banks
title_zh: 美元融资脆弱性与非美国全球银行

abstract: We develop novel high-frequency indices that measure climate attention across a wide range of developed and emerging economies. By analyzing the text of over 23 million Tweets published by leading national newspapers, we find that a country experiencing more severe climate news shocks tends to see both an inflow of capital and an appreciation of its currency. In addition, brown stocks experience large and persistent negative returns after a global climate news shock if located in highly exposed countries. A risk-sharing model in which investors price climate news shocks and trade consumption and investment goods in global markets rationalizes these findings.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了覆盖发达与新兴经济体的新型高频气候关注度指数。通过分析2300余万条主流全国性报纸推文文本，研究发现：遭受更严重气候新闻冲击的国家往往出现资本流入与本币升值。此外，若棕色股票所在国气候暴露度较高，全球气候新闻冲击将导致其持续大幅负收益。基于投资者对气候新闻冲击定价、并在全球市场交易消费与投资品的风险分担模型，可合理解释上述发现。
title: International Climate News
title_zh: 国际气候新闻

abstract: Chinese private portfolio equity outflows, though small compared to other Chinese outflows, are growing rapidly because of capital account liberalization and capital flight. Using granular stock-holding data on Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) mutual funds, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stocks. Event study analysis around monetary policy announcement days reveals that monetary policy tightening depresses returns of country equity indexes and individual U.S. stocks with QDII fund exposure relative to non-exposed stocks. The results are robust to controlling for the real transmission channel of Chinese monetary policy and other confounders. The effect is driven by smaller and less liquid firms, but not by China-concept stocks or those highly exposed to China
abstract_zh: 中国私人投资组合的股权流出规模虽不及其他类型的中国资本流出，但受资本账户自由化和资本外逃推动，正呈现快速增长态势。基于合格境内机构投资者（QDII）共同基金的股票持仓微观数据，我们识别出中国货币政策向全球股市传导的新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公告日的事件研究分析表明，相较于未受QDII基金持仓的股票，货币政策紧缩会压低受QDII基金持仓的国家股指及美国个股的收益率。在控制中国货币政策实际传导渠道及其他混杂因素后，该结论依然稳健。这一效应主要由规模较小、流动性较差的股票驱动，而非中国概念股或与中国高度关联的股票。

abstract: TThis paper provides econometric evidence on how exchange rates respond to tariffs. We construct a new tariff-shock database, which captures tariff-related announcements, threats and implementations by the U.S., China, the Euro Area and Canada between 2018 and 2020, and in 2025. Our shock measure accounts for both the size of tariff rates and their economic relevance. Over the 2018-2020 period, we show that exchange rates reacted to U.S. tariff shocks in systematically different ways depending on retaliation: the U.S. dollar (USD) appreciated if the tariff was imposed unilaterally, but depreciated if other countries threatened to retaliate. In 2025, when nearly all U.S. tariff actions were met with retaliatory threats, the USD again depreciated. In contrast to 2018-2020, however, long-maturity U.S. Treasury yields rose in 2025, instead of fell-consistent with an interpretation of â€˜Liberation Day' as a reserve-currency shock. This may reflect that U.S. tariff actions in 2025 were significantly larger, more frequent and targeted a broader set of countries.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于汇率如何对关税做出反应的计量经济学证据。我们构建了一个新的关税冲击数据库，涵盖了2018年至2020年以及2025年间美国、中国、欧元区和加拿大与关税相关的公告、威胁和实施措施。我们的冲击度量既考虑了关税税率的大小，也考虑了其经济相关性。在2018-2020年期间，我们发现汇率对美国关税冲击的反应因报复行为而呈现系统性差异：若关税为单方面实施，美元（USD）升值；若其他国家威胁报复，则美元贬值。2025年，当几乎所有美国关税行动都遭遇报复威胁时，美元再次贬值。然而，与2018-2020年不同的是，2025年美国长期国债收益率上升而非下降——这与将“解放日”解读为储备货币冲击的解释一致。这可能反映出2025年美国关税行动的规模显著更大、频率更高，且针对的国家范围更广。
china_relevance_reason: 研究明确包含中国作为核心关税冲击来源和汇率反应分析对象，数据涵盖中国2018-2025年关税政策
title: Trading Blows: The Exchange-Rate Response to Tariffs and Retaliations
title_zh: 贸易冲击：关税与报复措施下的汇率反应

abstract: How do shifts in the global balance of power shape the world economy? We propose a theory of alignment-based "hegemonic globalization,â€ built on two central premises: countries differ in their preferences over policies (such as the rule of law or regulatory frameworks) and trade between any two countries increases with the degree of alignment in these policies. Hegemons promote policy alignment and thereby facilitate deeper trade integration. A unipolar world, dominated by a single hegemon, tends to support globalization. However, the transition to a multipolar world can trigger fragmentation, which is particularly costly for the declining hegemon and its closest allies. To test the theory, we use international treaties as a proxy for alignment and compile a novel "Global Treaty Database,â€ covering 77,000 agreements signed between 1800 and 2020. Consistent with the theory, we find that hegemons account for a disproportionate share of global treaty activity and that treaty-signing is a leading indicator of increasing bilateral trade.
abstract_zh: 全球权力格局的变迁如何塑造世界经济？本文提出一种基于政策协调的"霸权全球化"理论，其核心前提有二：各国对政策（如法治体系或监管框架）存在偏好差异，且两国间的贸易规模随政策协调程度提升而扩大。霸权国通过推动政策协调促进贸易深度融合。由单一霸权主导的单极世界往往有利于全球化进程，但向多极世界的转型可能引发体系碎片化，这对衰落中的霸权国及其核心盟友造成的代价尤为高昂。为验证该理论，我们以国际条约作为政策协调的代理变量，构建了涵盖1800年至2020年间7.7万项协定的新型"全球条约数据库"。实证结果与理论预测一致：霸权国在全球条约活动中占据不成比例的份额，且条约签署是双边贸易增长的先行指标。
title: Hegemonic Globalization
title_zh: 霸权全球化

abstract: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities—or kinks—in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001–2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that, while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times steeper when the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially due to more rigid labor markets. Our estimates suggest, however, that despite this nonlinearity, most of the post-pandemic inflation surge is attributable to factors other than labor market tightness.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并允许劳动力市场松弛与通胀之间的关系存在非线性——即拐点。我们利用2001-2024年期间各国劳动力市场状况的跨国差异，通过时间固定效应吸收了总体冲击和内生性货币政策反应。研究发现，尽管菲利普斯曲线通常较为平坦，但当劳动力市场足够紧张时，其斜率至少会陡峭三倍。这一拐点在欧元区比美国更为显著，可能源于欧元区更为僵化的劳动力市场。然而，我们的估计表明，尽管存在这种非线性特征，疫情后通胀飙升的主要原因并非劳动力市场紧张，而是其他因素。
title: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the regional Phillips curve in the euro area
title_zh: 扭曲的欧洲：来自欧元区区域菲利普斯曲线的证据

abstract: Business plan competitions aim to identify and spur high-growth entrepreneurs. Two experiments were embedded into in a Kenyan competition to test how intensity of selection and of capital determine entrepreneurial outcomes. Applicants received a US$9,000 grant after a streamlined process or went through multiple selection stages and were randomly assigned US$9,000 or US$36,000. All grants initially generated jobs, but the impacts only persisted over three years under multi-stage selection. The larger grants did not yield greater long-term impacts than the multi-stage US$9,000 grant, suggesting diminishing returns to capital and limited lumpy investment opportunities. Selection, rather than grant size, determines long-run firm growth.
abstract_zh: 商业计划竞赛旨在识别并激励高成长型企业家。通过在肯尼亚的一场竞赛中嵌入两项实验，本研究检验了筛选强度与资本规模如何决定创业成果。申请者经简化流程后获得9000美元资助，或需通过多阶段筛选并随机分配9000美元或36000美元。所有资助最初均创造了就业岗位，但只有经过多阶段筛选的资助在三年后仍持续产生效应。更大规模的资助并未比多阶段筛选下的9000美元资助带来更显著的长期影响，这表明资本存在边际收益递减效应，且大规模投资机会有限。决定企业长期增长的关键因素是筛选机制，而非资助金额。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Selection or More Capital? Experimental Evidence on High-Growth Entrepreneurs in Kenya
title_zh: 选择还是更多资本？肯尼亚高增长企业家的实验证据

abstract: Conditional cash transfers (CCTs) have been found to have several benefits, particularly with respect to educational outcomes of targeted children. However, concerns have also been raised that CCTs may further push women into traditional gender norms, as they make mothers responsible for ensuring that their children meet the conditionalities and that their family receives the transfer. We analyze 2020–21 time use data from Colombia, and find that the CCT Familias en Acción increased the time that mothers allocated to domestic work, particularly when they have children aged 6–14. This pattern does not come from a substitution between children’s and mothers’ domestic labor, but, rather, reveals that the cash transfer enabled women to decrease their labor force participation during the pandemic – but that their time was then reallocated toward more domestic work, following traditional norms.
abstract_zh: 有条件现金转移（CCTs）已被发现具有多项益处，尤其是在改善目标儿童的教育成果方面。然而，也有人担忧，CCTs可能进一步将女性推向传统性别规范，因为它们要求母亲负责确保子女满足条件要求，并确保家庭获得转移支付。我们分析了哥伦比亚2020-21年的时间使用数据，发现CCT项目“家庭行动”增加了母亲分配给家务劳动的时间，尤其是在她们有6-14岁子女的情况下。这一模式并非源于儿童与母亲家务劳动之间的替代，而是揭示了现金转移使女性在疫情期间能够减少劳动力参与——但她们的时间随后被重新分配至更多家务劳动，遵循了传统规范。
title: Cash transfers and time use within the household: an analysis of the effect of Familias en Acción
title_zh: 家庭内部的现金转移与时间利用：Familias en Acción项目效应分析

abstract: Pension funds use interest rate swaps to hedge the interest rate risk arising from their liabilities. Analyzing regulatory data on Dutch pension funds, we show that pension funds with worse funding ratios, indicating greater fragility, use swaps more aggressively. These swap positions expose pension funds to the risk of margin calls, which can exceed 6% of their total assets, when interest rates rise. Pension funds respond to realized margin calls by selling safe government bonds with medium-term maturities. This procyclical selling behavior adversely affects the prices of the sold bonds and thereby exposes pension funds to market liquidity risk. (JEL E43, G12, G18)
abstract_zh: 养老基金利用利率互换来对冲其负债产生的利率风险。通过分析荷兰养老基金的监管数据，我们发现，资金状况较差（即脆弱性更高）的养老基金更激进地使用互换。这些互换头寸使养老基金面临追加保证金的风险，当利率上升时，追加金额可能超过其总资产的6%。面对已实现的保证金追缴，养老基金通过出售中期安全政府债券来应对。这种顺周期抛售行为对出售债券的价格产生不利影响，从而使养老基金面临市场流动性风险。（JEL E43, G12, G18）
title: Pension Liquidity Risk
title_zh: 养老金流动性风险

abstract: We collect and analyze detailed filings from global institutional investors to estimate foreign investors’ U.S. dollar (USD) security holdings and currency hedging. Over two decades, foreign USD holdings grew sixfold, while hedge ratios rose by 15 percentage points after the 2008–2009 crisis. Currency hedging across mutual funds, pensions, and insurance reached $2 trillion by 2019. Hedging demand varies across investors, currency areas, and banking systems. We show that expected FX returns, beyond variance minimization, drive currency exposure in portfolios. Finally, we demonstrate and quantify how aggregate hedging demand affects hedging costs in the presence of constrained intermediaries. (JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23)
abstract_zh: 我们收集并分析了全球机构投资者的详细申报文件，以估算外国投资者的美元证券持有量及货币对冲情况。在二十年间，外国美元持有量增长了六倍，而2008-2009年危机后对冲比率上升了15个百分点。截至2019年，共同基金、养老金和保险公司的货币对冲规模达到2万亿美元。对冲需求因投资者、货币区域和银行体系的不同而存在差异。我们证明，除方差最小化外，预期外汇回报率也驱动着投资组合中的货币敞口。最后，我们展示并量化了在存在受限中介机构的情况下，总对冲需求如何影响对冲成本。（JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23）
title: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe
title_zh: 全球美元资产持有与对冲

abstract: We show that politicians facing a binding term limit are more likely to engage in financial deliberalization than those facing reelection, but only in the wake of a financial crisis. In particular, they implement policies that tend to favor incumbent financial institutions over the general population, such as increasing barriers to entry in the banking sector. We propose a conceptual framework and several mechanisms to rationalize this behavior and show that revolving doors between the government and the financial sector play a key role in encouraging bank‐friendly policies after crises.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，面临任期限制的政客比面临连任的政客更有可能实施金融去自由化，但仅在金融危机之后如此。具体而言，他们倾向于实施有利于现有金融机构而非普通民众的政策，例如提高银行业准入门槛。我们提出了一个概念框架和若干机制来解释这一行为，并表明政府与金融部门之间的旋转门在危机后鼓励亲银行政策方面发挥了关键作用。
title: Political Accountability During Crises: Evidence From 40 Years of Financial Policies
title_zh: 危机时期的政治问责：来自40年金融政策的证据

abstract: Motivated by the problem of organizational design, we study coordination in the network minimum game : a version of the minimum-effort game where players are connected by a directed network. We show experimentally that acyclic networks such as hierarchies are most conducive to successful coordination. Introducing a single link to complete a network cycle may drastically inhibit coordination. Furthermore, acyclic networks enable resilient coordination: initial coordination failure is often overcome (exacerbated) after repeated play in acyclic (cyclic) networks.
abstract_zh: 受组织设计问题的启发，我们研究了网络最小博弈中的协调问题：该博弈是最小努力博弈的一个变体，其中参与者通过有向网络相互连接。实验结果表明，层级结构等无环网络最有利于实现成功协调。引入单一链接以形成网络环可能会严重抑制协调。此外，无环网络能够实现具有韧性的协调：在无环（有环）网络中，初始协调失败往往会在重复博弈后被克服（加剧）。
title: Coordination in the network minimum game
title_zh: 网络最小博弈中的协调

abstract: This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业层面违约风险引发的信贷摩擦对总体经济表现的影响。我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观-宏观模型，表明感知违约风险是信贷摩擦的充分统计量。利用英国行政数据（2004-2019年）与标普风险指标匹配，反事实估计显示，放松信贷摩擦可使产出提高25%，工资提高23%。忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而固定资本错配方法则会低估产出收益。大部分收益源于总体资本积累。信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平，重塑了企业规模动态，加剧了企业间的资源错配，并长期抑制了生产率增长。
title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
title_zh: 信贷摩擦的均衡影响：基于企业层面数据违约风险的证据

abstract: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has urged a coordinated “public health approach” to combatting bullying in schools, in part due to concerns that bullying victimization causes teens to turn to risky behaviors as a coping mechanism. This study provides new evidence on the effect of anti-bullying laws (ABLs) on youth risky health behaviors. Using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveys and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find little evidence that ABL adoption leads to statistically significant or economically meaningful reductions in binge drinking, tobacco use, marijuana use, risky sex, or body weight for the average teenager. However, for some historically marginalized youth—particularly those who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, or questioning—we find some evidence of ABL-induced improvements in behavioral health, especially with respect to binge drinking. This finding is consistent with disproportionate ABL health gains for queer youth.
abstract_zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部呼吁采取协调一致的“公共卫生方法”来应对校园欺凌问题，部分原因是担心遭受欺凌会导致青少年将高风险行为作为应对机制。本研究为反欺凌法对青少年高风险健康行为的影响提供了新证据。基于青少年风险行为调查数据及广义双重差分法，我们发现几乎没有证据表明反欺凌法的实施会导致普通青少年在暴饮、吸烟、大麻使用、危险性行为或体重方面出现统计显著或经济意义上的显著减少。然而，对于部分历史上处于边缘地位的青少年——尤其是那些自认为女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋或性取向不确定的青少年——我们发现一些证据表明反欺凌法改善了其行为健康，特别是在暴饮方面。这一发现与反欺凌法对性少数青少年健康收益不成比例的现象一致。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Anti-bullying laws and youth risky health behaviors
title_zh: 反欺凌法律与青少年危险健康行为

abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Three Supplies and Two Platforms (TSTP) programme, a large-scale computer-assisted learning (CAL) initiative in China, on the cognitive skills of lower secondary students. We draw on nationally representative panel data from the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS) and implement a difference-in-differences (DID) strategy to identify causal effects. The results indicate that TSTP increases students’ cognitive test scores by 0.177 standard deviations. We provide suggestive evidence that these gains may operate through changes in teachers’ instructional tools and practices, improvements in students’ learning experiences and learning-related skills, and increased parental engagement. The effects are heterogeneous, with larger impacts observed among disadvantaged students, particularly those with lower baseline achievement and those attending rural schools. In addition, the programme reduces the rural–urban cognitive achievement gap by 0.079 standard deviations. Overall, the findings suggest that large-scale CAL interventions can enhance cognitive outcomes and contribute to reducing educational inequality in developing country contexts. KEYWORDS: Computer-assisted learning Three Supplies and Two Platforms China cognitive skills rural–urban disparities JEL CLASSIFICATION: I21 I24 I28
abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国大规模计算机辅助学习（CAL）项目——“三通两平台”（TSTP）对初中生认知技能的影响。我们利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）中具有全国代表性的面板数据，采用双重差分（DID）策略识别因果效应。结果表明，TSTP使学生的认知测试成绩提高了0.177个标准差。我们提供的初步证据表明，这些成效可能通过教师教学工具与实践的变革、学生学习体验及学习相关技能的提升，以及家长参与度的增加来实现。该效应存在异质性，在弱势学生群体中影响更为显著，尤其是基线成绩较低的学生和农村学校学生。此外，该项目使城乡认知成就差距缩小了0.079个标准差。总体而言，研究结果表明，大规模CAL干预能够提升认知成果，并有助于缩小发展中国家背景下的教育不平等。关键词：计算机辅助学习；三通两平台；中国；认知技能；城乡差距 JEL分类：I21 I24 I28

title: The impact of computer-assisted learning on students’ cognitive skills: evidence from the “Three Supplies and Two Platforms” programme in China
title_zh: 计算机辅助学习对学生认知技能的影响：来自中国“三个课堂”项目的证据

abstract: Agricultural production systems around the globe are experiencing significant climate-driven pressures. As climate change effects intensify, agricultural adaptation must align with climate sustainability policy and consumers who are attentive to production that reduce supply-chain emissions. This study provides case-study evidence from New Zealand, where warming climatic conditions are driving exploration of alternative horticultural land uses such as bananas, and where consumer demand may influence whether such diversification pathways are commercially viable. We examine how preferences for cleaner production attributes shape banana demand using a discrete choice experiment of banana consumers designed to assess the effects of organic and spray-free production, carbon-zero claims, and local origin on consumer choices. A Latent Class Analysis identified preference heterogeneity finding 38% of consumers state willingness to pay for low environmental impact attributes: organic (+76%), spray-free (+33%) and carbon-zero (+23%), indicating potential demand for environmentally produced bananas aligned with a changing climate. The findings suggest that a differentiated domestic banana product could support sustainable production and climate-adaptive diversification but should be interpreted as case study stated-preference demand-side evidence rather than as an assessment of industry feasibility. Further evidence on production costs, supply-chain logistics, and revealed demand is needed before drawing stronger conclusions about commercial potential.
abstract_zh: 全球农业生产系统正面临显著的气候变化压力。随着气候变化影响加剧，农业适应措施必须与气候可持续政策及关注供应链减排的消费者需求相协调。本研究以新西兰为案例，该国气候变暖正推动香蕉等替代性园艺土地利用方式的探索，而消费者需求可能影响此类多元化路径的商业可行性。我们通过香蕉消费者离散选择实验，考察清洁生产属性偏好如何塑造香蕉需求，旨在评估有机生产、无农药生产、碳中和声明及本地来源对消费者选择的影响。潜在类别分析揭示了偏好异质性，发现38%的消费者愿意为低环境影响的属性支付溢价：有机（+76%）、无农药（+33%）和碳中和（+23%），这表明对适应气候变化的环境友好型香蕉存在潜在需求。研究结果表明，差异化本土香蕉产品可支持可持续生产与气候适应性多元化，但应将其解读为案例研究中的陈述偏好需求侧证据，而非行业可行性评估。在得出关于商业潜力的更可靠结论前，仍需进一步获取生产成本、供应链物流及显示性需求方面的证据。
title: Sustainable adaptation in agriculture: exploring consumer support for low-carbon climate resilient crops
title_zh: 农业可持续适应：消费者对低碳气候韧性作物的支持研究

abstract: Artificial intelligence is becoming a key input in corporate transformation, yet its effects on workforce skill structure remain underexplored. Drawing on skill-biased technological change theory, this study examines AI investment’s effect on the share of highly educated labour and the mediating role of administrative expense ratio. Using panel data of Chinese A-share listed firms (2015–2024), this research finds that a 1% increase in AI investment raises the proportion of employees with a master’s degree or above by about 0.0009% points – significant but modest, reflecting high-skilled talent supply lag. The direct positive effect is partially offset by an indirect negative effect via reduced administrative expense ratio. The effect is strongest in services, weaker in industry, and insignificant in agriculture; it is also significant in non-state-owned enterprises but not in state-owned ones. These findings suggest AI affects skill structure through both production and organizational channels, with implications for firm strategy and policy. KEYWORDS: Artificial intelligence investment skill structure of the corporate workforce administrative expense ratio skill-biased technological change theory JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 G15
abstract_zh: 人工智能正成为企业转型的关键投入要素，但其对劳动力技能结构的影响尚未得到充分探讨。基于技能偏向型技术变革理论，本研究考察了人工智能投资对高学历劳动力占比的影响，以及管理费用率的中介作用。利用2015—2024年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，研究发现：人工智能投资每增加1%，硕士及以上学历员工占比约提高0.0009个百分点——这一效应虽显著但幅度较小，反映出高技能人才供给的滞后性。直接正向效应部分被管理费用率下降带来的间接负向效应所抵消。该效应在服务业中最强，在工业中较弱，在农业中不显著；在非国有企业中显著，在国有企业中则不显著。这些发现表明，人工智能通过生产渠道和组织渠道共同影响技能结构，对企业战略与政策制定具有启示意义。关键词：人工智能投资；企业劳动力技能结构；管理费用率；技能偏向型技术变革理论；JEL分类：O33 G15

title: How does artificial intelligence investment optimize the skill structure of enterprise labour force? Evidence from Chinese listed companies
title_zh: 人工智能投资如何优化企业劳动力技能结构？来自中国上市公司的证据

abstract: I study the interaction between spiteful preferences and interdependent values in auctions. While spite causes overbidding in both auction formats, interdependent values affect spiteful bidders' incentives differently depending on the auction format. Relative to independent values, bidders with interdependent values are less affected by spite in first‐price auctions, but more affected in second‐price auctions: the decrease in bid shading is smaller in the former, while the increase in above‐value bidding is greater in the latter. This format‐dependent behaviour reflects the trade‐off between increased competitiveness driven by spite and caution induced by the winner's curse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了拍卖中恶意偏好与相互依存价值的交互作用。尽管恶意行为在两种拍卖形式中均导致过度出价，但相互依存价值对恶意竞拍者激励的影响因拍卖形式而异。相较于独立价值，具有相互依存价值的竞拍者在第一价格拍卖中受恶意影响较小，但在第二价格拍卖中受恶意影响更大：前者中出价折扣的降幅较小，而后者中高于价值出价的增幅较大。这种依赖于拍卖形式的行为，反映了恶意驱动的竞争性增强与赢家诅咒引发的谨慎性之间的权衡。
title: Interdependent‐value auctions with spiteful bidders
title_zh: 恶意竞拍者参与的相互依赖价值拍卖

abstract: We study how the interaction between demographic changes and spatial sorting affects marriage matching across space. Using data from China, we first present stylized facts on the diverging spatial distribution of singlehood characterized by a high singles rate for females (males) in more (less) developed cities. We then build a quantitative spatial equilibrium model. It reveals that more highly educated women sort into the service sector in more developed cities than men. With persistent social norms of hypergamy, this results in more failed marriage matches for females (males) in more (less) developed cities, thereby lowering the national marriage rate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人口结构变化与空间分选之间的相互作用如何影响跨区域的婚姻匹配。利用中国数据，我们首先呈现了单身现象空间分布分化的典型事实：在较发达城市，女性单身率较高；而在欠发达城市，男性单身率较高。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型。模型揭示，相较于男性，更多高学历女性倾向于在较发达城市的服务部门集聚。在持续存在的“上嫁”社会规范下，这导致较发达城市中女性婚姻匹配失败率上升，而欠发达城市中男性婚姻匹配失败率上升，进而降低了全国婚姻率。

abstract: This paper examines the rapid expansion and convergence of retail betting markets. We analyze market design elements, discuss economic utility, and highlight shared behavioral drivers of sports betting markets, prediction markets, and retail options trading. Our review underscores how technological innovation, behavioral biases, and regulatory arbitrage have shaped recent market evolution. We highlight important considerations for policy-makers facing a changing landscape and outline possibilities for further research.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了零售博彩市场的快速扩张与趋同现象。我们分析了市场设计要素，探讨了经济效用，并揭示了体育博彩市场、预测市场与零售期权交易共有的行为驱动因素。本综述强调技术创新、行为偏差与监管套利如何塑造了近期市场演变。我们为面临不断变化格局的政策制定者提出重要考量，并勾勒出未来研究的可能性方向。
title: Retail Betting Markets
title_zh: 零售博彩市场

abstract: We document a robust industry-level distress anomaly in which more distressed industries earn significantly lower expected equity returns. The anomaly is distinct from the firm-level distress anomaly (Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008). It remains significant after controlling for firm-level distress but disappears in placebo industries formed by randomly reshuffling firms across actual industries. Both theoretically and empirically, we show that competition-distress feedback amplifies the exposure of industry profit margins and equity returns to discount-rate shocks. Industries with greater idiosyncratic left-tail risk are more distressed but exhibit weaker competition-distress feedback. This effect reduces their exposure to discount-rate shocks and thus lowers their expected equity returns.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一个稳健的行业层面困境异象，即困境程度更高的行业获得的预期股票收益率显著更低。该异象与公司层面的困境异象（Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008）存在显著差异。在控制公司层面困境后，该异象依然显著，但在通过随机重组实际行业中的公司所形成的虚拟行业中则消失。理论与实证均表明，竞争-困境反馈机制放大了行业利润率与股票收益率对贴现率冲击的暴露程度。具有更大特质性左尾风险的行业困境程度更高，但其竞争-困境反馈效应更弱。这一效应降低了这些行业对贴现率冲击的暴露程度，从而降低了其预期股票收益率。
title: Industry Distress Anomaly
title_zh: 行业困境异象

abstract: A decline in credit scores can worsen the borrower's financial position, making default a self-fulfilling prophecy. We estimate the causal effect of credit scores on default using a rule that counts multiple inquiries within 14 days as one, moving scores without changing credit reports. Regression discontinuity estimates around the 14-day cut-off show that an additional counted inquiry lowers scores by five points on average. Default does not respond among consumers with clean records, but rises by 3.2 percentage points over two years among those with prior derogatories. For these consumers, at least 13 percent of the relationship between scores and default is self-fulfilling. We show that scorers would want to limit self-fulfilling defaults if their objective is forecast accuracy, but not if it is separating defaulters from non-defaulters, because that objective rewards the score for the defaults it causes.
abstract_zh: 信用评分下降可能恶化借款人的财务状况，使违约成为自我实现的预言。我们利用一项规则——将14天内多次查询合并为一次，从而在不改变信用报告的情况下调整评分——来估计信用评分对违约的因果效应。基于14天临界点的断点回归估计显示，每增加一次被计入的查询平均会使评分降低5分。在信用记录良好的消费者中，违约并未出现显著变化；但在有不良记录的消费者中，两年内违约率上升了3.2个百分点。对于这些消费者而言，评分与违约之间至少13%的关系是自我实现的。研究表明，若评分机构的目标是预测准确性，它们会倾向于限制自我实现的违约；但若目标是区分违约者与非违约者，则不会如此，因为后一目标会因评分引发的违约而奖励该评分。
title: Self-Fulfilling Credit Scores
title_zh: 自我实现的信用评分

abstract: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.
abstract_zh: 经济激励可能促进疫苗接种，但其成本效益取决于能否精准锁定最易响应的患者群体。我们在2021-2022年流感季期间，对某整合医疗系统中57,579名成年患者开展随机对照试验。将近期有预约的患者随机分为四组：无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组、最高价值5000美元的刮刮乐彩票激励组。任何主动干预措施均使预约接种率提升2个百分点（较对照组均值增长8%），整个流感季接种率提升1.5个百分点。三个干预组间无显著差异，表明小额经济激励相较于单纯提醒并未产生额外效益。我们利用电子健康档案与区域特征数据，通过因果森林模型估计条件平均处理效应。预测响应度呈现显著异质性：响应度最高四分位患者对激励措施的反应概率是低四分位患者的3-4倍，而提醒效应的异质性相对较小。研究结果表明，低成本提醒可提升流感疫苗接种率，机器学习方法则有助于识别对小额经济激励最敏感的患者群体。
title: Effects of Lottery Incentives for Influenza Vaccination: Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Trial and Causal Forest Analysis
title_zh: 彩票激励对流感疫苗接种的影响：来自大规模随机试验与因果森林分析的证据

abstract: Progressive taxation is central to high-income countries' tax systems, but developing countries typically rely on less progressive instruments. We study the introduction of progressive property taxation in a large Congolese city through a citywide field experiment conducted in partnership with the provincial government. Neighborhoods were randomly assigned to a progressive or a proportional schedule. The progressive schedule increased revenue by 56% relative to the proportional one. Gains occurred throughout the property value distribution: at the top, higher statutory rates mechanically raised revenue despite modest compliance losses; at the bottom, lower rates induced compliance gains large enough to offset lower liabilities. Cross-randomized information treatments show that taxpayers responded primarily to their own rates, not to others' rates or to the perceived fairness of the overall schedule. Effective tax rates – taxes paid as a share of property value – declined with property value and were most regressive under the progressive schedule. However, after a progressive schedule was scaled up citywide in subsequent years, targeted enforcement among high-value properties reversed this pattern, aligning statutory and effective rates. Together, the results suggest that progressive property taxation can raise fiscal capacity in low-income settings and, when paired with targeted enforcement, further shift the tax burden onto wealthier property owners.
abstract_zh: 累进税制是高收入国家税收体系的核心，但发展中国家通常采用累进性较弱的税制。我们与省政府合作，在刚果某大城市开展了一项全市范围的实地实验，研究累进财产税的引入效果。社区被随机分配至累进税率或比例税率方案。相较于比例税率，累进税率使税收收入增加56%。这一增长覆盖了全部房产价值区间：在高端房产中，尽管存在适度的合规损失，但更高的法定税率机械性地提升了收入；在低端房产中，较低的税率带来的合规收益足以抵消税负减少的影响。交叉随机信息干预实验表明，纳税人主要对自身税率做出反应，而非他人税率或整体税制的公平性感知。有效税率（即实际缴纳的税款占房产价值的比例）随房产价值递减，且在累进税制下呈现最强的累退性。然而，当累进税制在后续年份推广至全市范围后，针对高价值房产的定向执法扭转了这一趋势，使法定税率与有效税率趋于一致。综合来看，研究结果表明：累进财产税能够提升低收入地区的财政汲取能力，若配合定向执法，可进一步将税负转移至更富裕的房产所有者。
title: Does Progressivity Raise Tax Capacity? Experimental Evidence from the D.R. Congo
title_zh: 累进性是否提升税收能力？来自刚果（金）的实验证据

abstract: We document arguably unintended returns of biodiversity conservation to science discovery, exploiting the 2002 fishing ban in China—an ecosystem restoration policy without explicit science-related objectives, which allows us to implement a difference-in-differences design across fish species. We find that the ban substantially increased research on affected species: funded programs rose by 21.5%, total funding by 22.8%, publications per program by 97.0%, and citations per paper by 106.7%. The effect is concentrated among researchers with geographic access to the river, and is stronger for non-extinct species and non-farmed fish species, suggesting that conservation expanded the supply of biological materials available for research. The ban also increased related public influence and patents. These results reveal that biodiversity conservation generates a significant scientific dividend through the restoration of natural research inputs, with implications for evaluating the broader benefits of ecosystem protections in an underdiscussed dimension for the science of science.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了生物多样性保护对科学发现的意外回报，利用2002年中国实施的禁渔令——一项没有明确科学相关目标的生态系统恢复政策，这使得我们能够对鱼类物种进行双重差分设计。研究发现，禁渔令显著增加了受影响物种的研究：资助项目数量上升21.5%，总资助金额增加22.8%，每个项目的论文产出提高97.0%，每篇论文的引用量增长106.7%。这一效应集中在具有河流地理接近性的研究人员中，且对非灭绝物种和非养殖鱼类更为显著，表明保护措施扩大了可供研究的生物材料供给。禁渔令还提升了相关的公众影响力及专利数量。这些结果揭示，生物多样性保护通过恢复自然研究投入产生了显著的科学红利，对在科学学中尚未充分讨论的维度上评估生态系统保护的更广泛效益具有启示意义。
